title: Demo: How Compound Interest Works (business explainer sample)

scenes.say: What if a hundred dollars a month could turn into over a hundred and twenty thousand?
With simple interest, you only earn on the money you put in.
But with compound interest, your earnings start earning too. Like a snowball rolling downhill.
Invest a hundred dollars a month for thirty years, at seven percent. You put in thirty-six thousand... and end up with about a hundred and twenty-two thousand.
Wait ten years to start, and you'd end with only about fifty-two thousand.
The secret ingredient is time. Start small. Start today.
